samples.note: Isolated CODEX_HOME plus a local mock Responses server produced three real item/commandExecution/requestApproval requests over stdio; all resolved and completed. availableDecisions contained accept, acceptWithExecpolicyAmendment, and cancel, but not acceptForSession.
Ten consecutive turns completed on one stdio app-server process.
thread/shellCommand started a long shell turn, turn/interrupt resolved, turn/completed reported interrupted, and captured Windows descendants had zero survivors after cleanup.
thread/shellCommand completed a 1200-line command output without JSONL pipe blockage.
Isolated CODEX_HOME showed read-only thread/start did not persist trust, while workspace-write thread/start persisted trust_level=trusted for the workspace.

Isolated CODEX_HOME plus mock Responses created a thread, completed a turn, stopped the app-server process, started a fresh stdio app-server process, resumed the same threadId, and completed a second turn.
A local 1x1 PNG was sent as app-server localImage input and reached the mock Responses payload as input_image before turn/completed.

notes: Official Codex app-server documentation marks stdio as the default supported transport and websocket as experimental/unsupported.
The basic stdio sample proved initialize, initialized, model/list, thread/list, thread/start, turn/start, streamed notifications, and turn/completed.

Non-blocking notifications arrived while the turn was active, including configWarning, remoteControl/status/changed, mcpServer/startupStatus/updated, thread/status/changed, thread/tokenUsage/updated, and account/rateLimits/updated.

Approval request capability was verified with an isolated CODEX_HOME and local mock Responses SSE server patterned after upstream app-server tests, avoiding prompt-dependent model behavior while preserving the installed codex app-server stdio path.

Command approval availableDecisions is the request-level authority. The observed decisions were accept, acceptWithExecpolicyAmendment, and cancel; acceptForSession was not observed, so supportsSessionScope must remain false for command approvals.
The smoke runner now records child pid, exit signal, and Windows process-tree descendants; the measured cancellation sample captured 12 descendants and zero survivors after cleanup.
thread/shellCommand is suitable for smoke-only transport stress because it is explicit user-initiated command execution and runs outside the sandbox; do not expose it as adapter fallback behavior.

Project trust behavior is known: workspace-write thread/start can persist trust_level=trusted. The bridge mitigation is to start/resume threads as read-only and keep elevated workspace-write policy on turn/start rather than thread/start.
